description:
# TAPP Composition Module: LaserAblation

The shared **LaserAblation** block of the 2026-08-11 TAPP library, composed by **6 of the sixteen** delivery tables — 29 owned fields over 22 schema paths.

Generated by `tools/build_module_bb.py` from `Module_LaserAblation.csv` and its schema-path sidecar. Edit those, not the schema.

This is a **profile, not a vocabulary**: it asserts which properties a conforming procedure or analysis carries, all of them already defined by `tappDefinition` or `adaProduct`.

## The two `$defs`

| `$def` | composed into | properties | required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ProcedureIdentification` | a TAPP schema (`prov:Plan`) | 10 | 7 |
| `AnalysisIdentification` | a technique detail (`schema:Dataset`) | 2 | 1 |

Requiredness follows the TAPP tier matrix: a field Basic on a side is required there, Advanced is permitted, N/A is absent from that side entirely.

## Composing it

```yaml
allOf:
- $ref: ../../../BaseSchema/tappDefinition/schema.yaml
- $ref: ../../../BaseSchema/modules/laserAblation/schema.yaml#/$defs/ProcedureIdentification
- type: object
  properties: {}   # only what this technique itself owns
```

`allOf` composes constraints and cannot relax them: a technique composing this module accepts its required set in full.

$defs:
  ProcedureIdentification:
    title: LaserAblation on the procedure
    description: 'Composed into a TAPP (prov:Plan) schema: what the procedure asserts
      once, for every analysis that follows it.'

      schema:instrument:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object

                  schema:inDefinedTermSet: ada:vocab/instrumentType
              required:
              - schema:additionalType

              properties:
                schema:model:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    schema:name:
                      description: Manufacturer and model of the laser ablation system.
                      type: string
                      x-jsonld-id: http://schema.org/name
                  x-jsonld-id: http://schema.org/model
                ada:laserType:
                  description: Wavelength and type of the laser used for ablation
                    in nanometres.
                  anyOf:
                  - type: string
                  - type: array
                    items:
                      type: string
                  x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/laserType
                schema:name:
                  description: Type, design origin, and internal volume of the ablation
                    cell.
                  anyOf:
                  - type: string
                  - type: array
                    items:
                      type: string
                  x-jsonld-id: http://schema.org/name
                ada:laserSpotGeometryDefault:
                  description: "Shape and dimensions of the laser ablation spot in
                    micrometres registered by the procedure. For circular spots, report
                    diameter; for square or rectangular spots, report width \xD7 length."
                  anyOf:
                  - type: string
                  - type: array
                    items:
                      type: string
                  x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/laserSpotGeometryDefault
                ada:laserFluenceDefault:
                  description: "Laser pulse energy per unit area at the sample surface
                    in J cm\u207B\xB2, as registered by the procedure. If the system
                    reports only as % of maximum output, include that value and note
                    the system maximum where known."
                  anyOf:
                  - type: number
                  - type: string
                  x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/laserFluenceDefault
                ada:laserRepetitionRateDefault:
                  description: Laser pulse repetition rate in hertz registered by
                    the procedure.
                  anyOf:
                  - type: number
                  - type: string
                  x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/laserRepetitionRateDefault
        allOf:
        - contains:
            properties:
              schema:additionalType:
                contains:
                  const: Laser Ablation System
                schema:inDefinedTermSet: ada:vocab/instrumentType
            required:
            - schema:additionalType
        x-jsonld-id: http://schema.org/instrument
      ada:ablationSamplingMode:
        type: array
        items:
          description: Sampling mode or ablation pattern used during analysis.
          type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/ablationSamplingMode
      ada:ablationSpotDurationDefault:
        description: Total on-sample ablation (signal acquisition) time per individual
          spot in seconds, as set in the acquisition method. For transect analysis,
          the equivalent procedure-level parameter is scan speed (captured in Transect
          Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size). For mapping analysis, total acquisition
          time is sample-area-dependent and is not captured here.
        anyOf:
        - type: number
        - type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/ablationSpotDurationDefault
      ada:ablationPitDepthRateDefault:
        description: Depth of the ablation pit produced under the registered laser
          conditions, the method used to measure it, and the resulting per-pulse ablation
          rate. For transect and mapping the equivalent quantity is trench depth under
          the same conditions.
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/ablationPitDepthRateDefault
      ada:rasterLineSpacingDefault:
        description: Distance between adjacent raster lines in a 2D elemental map,
          measured perpendicular to the scan direction, in micrometres. Applies to
          raster mapping only.
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/rasterLineSpacingDefault
      ada:internalStandardApproach:
        description: Method used to determine the internal standard (IS) concentration
          for each unknown sample.
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/internalStandardApproach
      ada:sampleIntroduction:
        description: "Configuration by which the ablated aerosol is delivered to the
          plasma, including tubing, any signal-homogenising device, and any co-aspirated
          solution introduced alongside the aerosol \u2014 for example a Tl solution
          used for instrumental mass bias correction, or an isotopic spike used for
          isotope dilution. Distinct from the carrier and make-up gas fields, which
          record gas identity and flow rather than what else enters the plasma."
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/sampleIntroduction
      ada:backgroundCountTimeDefault:
        description: Total time spent measuring gas blank (background signal with
          laser off or shutter closed) before each ablation event, in seconds. For
          spot and transect analysis, a discrete background interval is measured before
          each ablation. For mapping, background is typically measured once per raster
          line or at the start of a map session rather than before each individual
          pixel.
        anyOf:
        - type: number
        - type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/backgroundCountTimeDefault
      ada:carrierGasFlowRateDefault:
        description: "Gas used to transport ablated aerosol from the ablation cell
          to the ICP-MS torch, with the procedure-registered target flow rate(s).
          Adjustment during tuning stays within \xB110% of the target."
        type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/carrierGasFlowRateDefault

        type: array
        items:
          description: Method used to correct for laser-induced elemental fractionation

            correction algorithm applied. Reference the software function or publication.
          type: string
        x-jsonld-id: https://ada.astromat.org/metadata/elementalFractionationCorrection
